For each scenario, multiple possible consequences were also identified. Each consequence was rated on a scale of 1-6, where 1 is low consequence and 6 is high consequence. An estimated likelihood or frequency on a scale of 1-5, where 1 is least likely and 5 is most likely to occur, was also assigned. The numerical values assigned to consequences and likelihoods were qualitatively determined, based on engineering judgement of each consequence, and applied on a relative basis so that scenarios could be compared. Low risk severity scenarios were those with ratings of 5 or less, medium severity between 6 and 15, and high severity consequences were those with a rating of 16 or above.
